title: Petra and the Summer
author: Wren Thackeray
blurb: Elodie Reyes, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
